title: Flute lullaby for the night shift
storyboard: Film: naturalist playing a traditional lullaby on bansuri at dusk by a lake; wide + hands close-up, 2 takes

scenes.headline: A traditional lullaby for animals that work nights
Can find prey in the dark by sound alone.
Does much of its hunting after dark.
Sleep tight. The night shift is just clocking in.

caption:
A lullaby, but the audience is wide awake.

A barn owl's face works like a satellite dish, funnelling sound to ears set at slightly different heights so it can pinpoint a mouse in total darkness.

Source: Cornell Lab of Ornithology, Britannica.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Medium risk (composition rights): instrumental cover of a public-domain traditional lullaby only, no lyrics on screen; original twist is a lullaby 'for' nocturnal animals with sourced facts.
